what: Check Propensity-Score Positivity and IPTW Weight Diagnostics — check_positivity
title: Check Propensity-Score Positivity and IPTW Weight Diagnostics — check_positivity
text: Inspects propensity-score distribution positivity (overlap) assumption reports distribution inverse-probability weights fit_outcome()'s IPTW method uses. Extreme propensity scores (near 0 1) extreme weights practical symptom positivity problems can produce unstable, high-variance IPTW/AIPW estimates even covariate balance looks fine average.

title: Check Propensity-Score Positivity and IPTW Weight Diagnostics — check_positivity
code: check_positivity(ps, threshold = c(0.01, 0.99), estimand = c("ATE", "ATT"))

title: Check Propensity-Score Positivity and IPTW Weight Diagnostics — check_positivity
text: ps IndepPSModel object returned build_ps_model(). threshold Length-2 numeric vector giving propensity-score support window. Scores first value second flagged positivity violations. Default c(0.01, 0.99). estimand Causal estimand whose IPTW weight distribution reported: "ATE" (default) reports stabilized inverse-probability weights /ps + (1-)/(1-ps); "ATT" reports standardized mortality ratio weights + (1-)*ps/(1-ps). match weights fit_outcome() actually uses.

title: Check Propensity-Score Positivity and IPTW Weight Diagnostics — check_positivity
text: list class "IndepPositivity" elements: threshold support window used. ps_by_group Data frame propensity-score quantiles exposure group, columns group, n, min, q25, median, q75, max. ps_violations List n_below, n_above, n_total — counts units whose propensity score falls outside threshold. violation Logical; TRUE propensity score falls outside threshold. weights List describing IPTW weight distribution requested estimand: estimand, n, min, median, max, max_min_ratio (largest divided smallest weight, extreme-weight summary).

title: Fit an Outcome Model with a Chosen Confounding-Adjustment Method — fit_outcome
text: data Data frame containing exposure, covariates, outcome. exposure Character; exposure variable name (binary). covariates Character vector covariate names. outcome Character; outcome variable name. type Outcome type: "binary" "continuous". method One "regression", "matching", "stratification", "iptw", "aipw". vector, returns list results, one per method. "matching" propensity-score matching conditional-logit (binary) / within-pair (continuous) estimation. estimand Causal estimand: "ATE" (default) "ATT". "ATT", propensity-score methods target average treatment effect treated: "iptw" "aipw" use standardized mortality ratio (SMR) weights, "stratification" pools stratum's within-stratum effect weights proportional number treated units stratum (Austin, 2011, doi:10.1080/00273171.2011.568786). "matching" targets ATT construction (1:1 matching without replacement) ignores argument — silent -op. "regression" reports conditional effect also ignores . trim Optional length-1 length-2 probability vector weight trimming, applied IPTW AIPW methods . Weights truncated specified percentiles distribution (Cole & Hernan 2008, doi:10.1093/aje/kwn085), trim = c(0.01, 0.99) caps extreme weights otherwise inflate variance. Default NULL (trimming, current behavior preserved exactly). Ignored "regression", "matching", "stratification". ... Passed per-method estimators. seed accepted matching method reproducible matching.

title: Fit an Outcome Model with a Chosen Confounding-Adjustment Method — fit_outcome
text: named list method, type, estimate, conf_low, conf_high, p_value, n, model. method length > 1, named list results.

title: Fit an Outcome Model with a Chosen Confounding-Adjustment Method — fit_outcome
text: "regression" adjusts covariates directly outcome model. "matching" propensity-score matching conditional-logit (binary) / within-pair (continuous) estimation. "stratification" stratifies propensity score. "iptw" marginal structural model: outcome model regresses exposure , weighted stabilized inverse probability treatment weights (SMR weights estimand = "ATT"), robust sandwich standard errors — confounding controlled weights alone. "aipw" doubly-robust augmented estimator (Bang & Robins) models outcome propensity score. method = "matching", binary outcomes must coded numeric 0/1 (conditional-logit estimator strata matched pair).

title: Fit an Outcome Model with a Chosen Confounding-Adjustment Method — fit_outcome
text: Austin PC. introduction propensity score methods reducing effects confounding observational studies. Multivariate Behavioral Research 2011;46(3):399-424, doi:10.1080/00273171.2011.568786. Austin 2011 source IPTW SMR weights treated-count pooling used estimand = "ATT". Lunceford JK, Davidian M. Stratification weighting via propensity score estimation causal treatment effects. Statistics Medicine 2004;23(19):2937-2960, doi:10.1002/sim.1903. Lunceford & Davidian (2004) source augmented influence-function ATE/ATT derivation used AIPW.

title: Run the IndepAssoc Analysis Pipeline — run_pipeline
text: data Data frame containing cohort. exposure Character string naming binary exposure variable. covariates Character vector covariate names. outcome Character string naming outcome variable. type Outcome type: "binary" "continuous". omitted auto-detected outcome variable: numeric logical vector whose values 0/1 treated "binary", numeric vector "continuous"; factor/character outcomes keep "binary" default. caliper Caliper matching (default 0.2). ratio Match ratio (default 1). balance_threshold ASMD threshold (default 0.10). methods Character vector confounding-adjustment methods run via fit_outcome() (default five: "regression", "matching", "stratification", "iptw", "aipw"). "matching" propensity-score matching conditional-logit (binary) / within-pair (continuous) estimation; matching draws data, results reproducible fixed seed set call. "iptw" marginal structural model (outcome regressed exposure , weighted stabilized inverse probability weights) "aipw" doubly-robust augmented estimator. seed Integer passed set.seed() top pipeline. fixed seed makes whole run — including step-2 matching step-9 "matching" method — reproducible single value. Default NULL (seeding). estimand Causal estimand passed fit_outcome(): "ATE" (default; current behavior) "ATT". "ATT", "iptw" "aipw" use standardized mortality ratio (SMR) weights "stratification" weights stratum's effect number treated units, propensity-score methods target average treatment effect treated (Austin 2011, doi:10.1080/00273171.2011.568786). "matching" always targets ATT construction ignores argument.

title: IndepAssoc 0.6.4 (2026-08-11)
text: Restores support two-level factor exposures (e.g. factor(exposure, labels = c("control", "treated"))), 0.6.3’s arm-count validation broken. build_ps_model() check_positivity() now normalize factor exposure way model fitting already : first factor level reference (control) arm second treated arm. Previously arm-count check compared raw column 0/1, factor whose levels literally "0"/"1" — completely ordinary way code binary exposure R — reported control units found data even arms present, check_positivity() returned NA weights. (#4) Arm coding now follows factor level order explicitly covered tests: level 1 always control level 2 always treated, regardless labels. pins semantics previously relied user coding control arm first silently flipped treated/control . (#5) 0.6.3’s degenerate-data validation unchanged: exposure genuinely empty single-unit arm still errors.

title: IndepAssoc 0.6.3 (2026-08-11)
text: Malformed argument values degenerate input now fail fast clear, actionable error instead silently succeeding surfacing generic downstream warning. match_cohort() errors caliper negative. negative caliper caliper = -0.2 previously ran MatchIt invalid caliper silently returned matched cohort. fit_outcome() method = "iptw" method = "aipw" errors trim bounds inverted (e.g. trim = c(0.9, 0.1)); previously range silently sorted. trim must ascending (lower, upper). check_positivity() errors threshold bounds inverted (e.g. threshold = c(0.99, 0.01)); previously inverted bounds silently mis-counted every unit outside support window. threshold must ascending (lower, upper). build_ps_model() errors data fewer 4 rows, either exposure arm empty, either arm contains fewer 2 units, warns either arm fewer 10 units. Previously n = 1, -treated, -control data “converged” degenerate propensity scores (1, 0, {0, 1}) produced NaN/Inf weights downstream, indication sample small. fit_outcome() fit_all_models() error zero-variance binary outcome. Previously -0 -1 outcome silently returned meaningless 1 (0-Inf confidence interval), NA, even impossible negative , generic glm.fit: algorithm converge warning — , mixed-effect model, skipped fit warning. error raised entry point (top-level outcome vector) message, run_pipeline() subgroup_analysis() inherit two entry points behave identically. constant outcome within matched subset subgroup, full cohort’s outcome varies, still degrades gracefully: affected model returns NA warning others unaffected. title: IndepAssoc 0.5.0
text: Initial public release.
